identity_and_theme.aesthetic_direction: High-density Dark Terminal with Electric Cyan accents, professional precision, and fast-paced trading feedback

pages_architecture.name: الرئيسية (Home)
key_elements: Live scrolling price ticker banner with 24h updates
Hero section with dynamic market indicators and quick trade widget
Live Market overview table with Top Gainers, Hot Pairs, and New Listings
Market Notifications & Real-time Deposit/Withdrawal activity toasts
Feature highlight cards (High Leverage Futures, Instant Spot, Security)
Mobile App download preview section

pages_architecture.name: الأسواق (Markets)
key_elements: Category tabs (USDT, Layer 1, AI, DeFi, Meme)
Search input with instant filtering
Comprehensive coin table with price, 24h % change, 24h high/low, 24h volume, sparklines, and direct action buttons

pages_architecture.name: التداول الفوري (Spot Trading Terminal)
key_elements: Trading pair top header with live price metrics
K-line Candlestick Chart with multi-timeframe toggles (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d)
Order Book displaying asks (red) and bids (green) with price precision and depth bars
Buy/Sell Order panel with Limit/Market tabs, percentage sliders (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%), and balance auto-fill
Recent Market Trades stream
User Open Orders, Order History, and Asset Balance panel

pages_architecture.name: العقود الآجلة (Futures Trading Terminal)
key_elements: Margin type selector (Cross / Isolated)
Leverage slider (1x up to 125x)
Open Long (Buy) and Open Short (Sell) execution forms
Liquidation price calculator and funding fee timer countdown

pages_architecture.name: الأصول والمحفظة (Assets & Wallet)
key_elements: Total Net Asset Value (USDT & USD balance display)
Quick Action buttons: Deposit (إيداع), Withdraw (سحب), Transfer (تحويل)
Demo Balance refill button with instant feedback
Asset list breakdown with hide zero balance toggle

pages_architecture.name: رسوم التحقق (Verification Fees)
key_elements: Custom AuraX Verification Fee status & instructions panel
Admin-configured fee amount indicator
Multi-network deposit addresses selector (TRC20, ERC20, BEP20, Solana)
QR code generator and copy address triggers
TXID submission form with status tracker (Pending/Verified)

pages_architecture.name: لوحة الآدمن (Admin Dashboard)
key_elements: Overview statistics (Total Users, System Volume, Fee Settings, Wallet Addresses)
User Management table (edit balances, adjust verification fee requirements, freeze accounts)
Verification Fee settings editor (update fee amounts & network deposit addresses)
Broadcast notifications modal (trigger site-wide deposit/withdrawal or market alerts)
Demo price generator velocity controller

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow RTL direction (`dir="rtl"`) for Arabic text across all pages and components.
Ensure numbers, prices, percentage changes, and crypto symbols (e.g. BTC/USDT, +5.24%, $64,230.50) use LTR font styling or JetBrains Mono for optimal tabular alignment.

Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, order forms, trade rows) feature explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="spot-buy-button"`, `data-testid="orderbook-bid-row-0"`).
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds on header, dropdown menus, popovers, or floating panels. Use backdrop-blur with minimum `bg-slate-900/95` or `bg-[#0B0E14]/95`.
Ensure live price updates simulate rapid market ticks with green flash animation for price increases and red flash for price decreases.
Ensure toast notifications using Sonner trigger periodic deposit/withdrawal alerts (e.g., 'قام مستخدم بسحب 1,500 USDT عبر شبكة TRC20').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_rules: Maintain high density trading terminal feel, zero generic templates, crisp 1px borders, glowing status accents, and strict contrast compliance.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_compliance: Include data-testid on every interactive element.
